senses.gloss: महा- + अङ्ग महा- + अङ्ग, m. a camel.
महा- + अचल महा- + अचल, m. a great mountain.
महा- + अत्यय महा- + अत्यय, 1. m. great pain, Chr. 11, 15. 2. adj. very pernicious, Chr. 22, 22.
महा- + अद्भुत महा- + अद्भुत adj. very surprising.
महा- + अनुभाव महा- + अनुभाव, adj. pre-eminent, just, virtuous.
महा- + अमात्य महा- + अमात्य, m. a minister.
मह- + अरण्य मह- + अरण्य, a large forest, Rām. 3, 52, 46.
महा- + अर्घ महा- + अर्घ, adj. of great value, Kathās. 21, 86.
महा- + अर्णव महा- + अर्णव, m. the ocean.

महा- + अर्थ महा- + अर्थ,
 I. m. a principal object.
 II. adj. 1. significant. 2. dignified.
महा- + अर्थवन्त् महा- + अर्थवन्त्, adj. very dignified.
महा- + अश्मन् महा- + अश्मन्, m. a ruby, Kir. 5, 8. []
महा-सती महा-सती, a very virtuous wife, Pañc. 38, 12. n. सत्, Entity, Man. 1, 11.
महा- + अस्त्र महा- + अस्त्र, n. a great missile weapon, Chr. 44, 4.
महा- + आत्मन् महा- + आत्मन्, adj. magnanimous, Pañc. ii. d. 153.
महा- + आनन महा- + आनन, adj. having a great mouth, Hiḍ. 3, 2.

महा- + आशय महा- + आशय,
 I. adj. 1. magnanimous; 2. liberal.
 II. m. a gentleman.
महा- + शय्या महा- + शय्या, f. a throne.
महा- + आहव महा- + आहव, m. a great battle or fight.
महा-इच्छ महा-इच्छ, adj. 1. highminded. 2. liberal.
महा- + इषुधि महा- + इषुधि, a great quiver.
महा- + इष्वास महा- + इष्वास, m. an archer.
महा- + ईश्वर महा- + ईश्वर, m. Śiva.
महा- + उच्छ्रय महा- + उच्छ्रय, adj. lofty, Rām. 3, 74, 14.
महा- + उत्पात महा- + उत्पात, adj. terrible, Pañc. 114, 14.

महा- + उत्साह महा- + उत्साह,
 I. adj. possessing great energy, persevering.
 II. m. 1. exertion. 2. a king possessing all the powers of monarchy.
महा- + उदधि महा- + उदधि, m. the great ocean.

महा- + उदय महा- + उदय,
 I. m. 1. prosperity. 2. final beatitude. 3. sovereignty. 4. a lord. 5. the country of Kanoj. 6. a proper name, Rājat. 5, 28.
 II. n. Kanoj.
महा- + उदर महा- + उदर, adj., f. री, having a large belly, Rām. 3, 23, 15.

महा- + उद्यम महा- + उद्यम,
 I. m. great effort.
 II. adj. making a strenuous effort, Rājat. 5, 136 (with infin.); 188 (with dat.).

महा- + उन्मद महा- + उन्मद, m. 1. intoxication, literally and figuratively.
 2. A sort of fish.
महा- + उपाध्याय महा- + उपाध्याय, m. a reverend master, Chr. 175, 1. 17.
महा-महा- + उपाध्याय महा-महा- + उपाध्याय, m. a very reverend master, Chr. 235, 6.
महा- + उरग महा- + उरग, m. a sort of demi-god of the serpent genus, inhabiting Pātāla.
महा- + उल्का महा- + उल्का, [] f. a great fireball, Man. 4, 103.
महा- + ऊर्मिन् महा- + ऊर्मिन्, adj. having great waves, MBh. 3, 793.
महौजस् महौजस्, i. e. महा-, adj. eminent in power, Man. 1, 61.
महौषधि महौषधि, i. e. महा-, f. a kind of sensitive plant, Mimosa pudica.

महा- + औषध महा- + औषध,
 I. n. 1. garlic. 2. long pepper.
 II. n. and f. धी, dry ginger.
महा- + कच्छ महा- + कच्छ, m. 1. the ocean. 2. Varuṇa. 3. a mountain.
महा-सम्- + कट महा-सम्- + कट, adj. full of great difficulties, Bhartṛ. 2, 98.
महा- + कन्द महा- + कन्द, m. 1. garlic. 2. a sort of yam. 3. a plant, Hingtsha repens.

महा- + काल महा- + काल,
 I. m. a name of Śiva.
 II. f. ली, Durgā.
महा- + काव्य महा- + काव्य, n. a classical poem, Chr. 170, 1.
महा- + गज महा- + गज, m. a great elephant, Pañc. 69, 1.
महा-ग्रीव महा-ग्रीव, m. a camel.
महा- + घूर्णा महा- + घूर्ण, f. णा, Spirituous liquor.
महा- + घोष महा- + घोष, n. a market.
महेन्द्र- + चाप महेन्द्र- + चाप, i. e. महा-इन्द्र-, m. the same, Rājat. 5, 381.
महा- + जन महा- + जन, m. 1. a preeminent man, a virtuous man. 2. a merchant.
महा- + जव महा- + जव, adj. very fleet.
महा- + तपस् महा- + तपस्, or सु-तपस्, adj. one who has practised great religious austerities, Chr. 39, 4.
महा- + तल महा- + तल, n. the name of a hell, Vedāntas. in Chr. 209, 2.
मही- + तल मही- + तल, m. or n. the earth, Rām. 3, 52, 36.

महा- + तेजस् महा- + तेजस्,
 I. adj. 1. very bright. 2. very vigorous.
 II. m. 1. fire. 2. a name of the god of war. 3. a demigod.
महा- + दण्ड महा- + दण्ड, m. heavy punishment, Chr. 61, 40.

महा- + देव महा- + देव,
 I. m. Śiva.
 II. f. वी. 1. Durgā. 2. a queen, Chr. 50, 7.
महा- + द्युति महा- + द्युति, adj. supremely glorious, Man. 1, 87.

महा महा,
 I. adj. 1. rich. 2. valuable.
 II. n. 1. (ved.) battle, Chr. 297, 17 = Rigv. i. 112, 17. 2. gold. 3. incense. 4. costly raiment. 5. agriculture.

महाऽ महा-, a substitute for महन्त्, when former part of compounds of the Bahuvrīhi and Karmadhāraya classes; e. g. महा-राज, m. A great king, Chr. 3, 4. महा-दुर्ग, adj. Very difficult to be crossed, Pañc. 123, 17. महा-तपस्, adj. Practising great austerities, Chr. 9, 39.

मह मह् + अ,
 I. adj. f. ही, Great, Chr. 288, 14 = Rigv. i. 88, 14.
 II. m.
 1. Light.
 2. A festival.
 3. A sacrifice.
 4. A buffalo.
 III. f. हा, A cow.
 IV. f. ही.
 1. The earth, Utt. Rāmac. 172, 13 (as deity); Daśak. in Chr. 179, 6; landed property, Pañc. i. d. 322.
 2. A cow.
 3. Name of a river.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. मईअ, मैअ᳓च्.
महा- + धनुष्मन्त् महा- + धनुष्मन्त्, m. a mighty archer.
महा- + धातु महा- + धातु, m. gold.
महिष- + ध्वज महिष- + ध्वज, m. Yama.
महा- + नट महा- + नट, m. Śiva.
महा-नदी महा-नदी, f. a great river, Rājat. 5, 98; = Gaṅgā, Chr. 26, 70.
महा- + नरक महा- + नरक, m. the name of a hell, Man. 4, 83.
महा- + नाद महा- + नाद, m. 1. a loud cry. 2. an elephant, 3. a lion. 4. a camel. 5. the ear.
महा-मेघ-ओघ- + निर्घोष महा-मेघ-ओघ- + निर्घोष, adj. sounding like a multitude of large thunder-clouds.
महा- + निश् महा- + निश्, f. the middle of the night, 4, 129.
महा- + निशा महा- + निशा, f. midnight.
महा- + नीच महा- + नीच, m. a washerman
महा- + नील महा- + नील, m. 1. the sapphire. 2. one of the Nāgas.
महा- + पक्ष महा- + पक्ष, adj. having a great family, Man. 8, 179.
मही- + पति मही- + पति, m. a king, Chr. 47, 32.

महा- + पद्म महा- + पद्म, []
 I. m. 1. one of the Nāgas. 2. one of Kuvera's treasures. 3. a Kiṃnara, or attendant on Kuvera. 4. a large number, one hundred thousand millions, MBh. 2, 2143. 5. the name of a lake, Rājat. 5, 68; 103.
 II. n. the white lotus.
महा- + पात महा- + पात, adj. falling with great force (as an arrow).
महा- + पातकिन् महा- + पातकिन्, adj. offending, or an offender, in the highest degree, Man. 9, 235.
महा- + पाप महा- + पाप, n. a sin of the highest degree. Yājñ. 3, 286.
महा-पुरी महा-पुरी, f. a great town.
महातमप्रभा महातमप्रभा, i. e. महा-तम- (for तमस्), f. the lowermost hell.
महा- + प्रलय महा- + प्रलय, m. 1. a destruction of the world occurring after every period of 4,320,000,000 years. 2. a total destruction of the universe.
महा- + प्रस्थान महा- + प्रस्थान, n. Death, Hariv. 11070.
महा- + प्राण महा- + प्राण, m. a raven.

महा- + फल महा- + फल,
 I. n. a great fruit, Bhartṛ. 2, 86.
 II. m. a fruit-tree, Aegle marmelos.
 III. f. ला, a bitter gourd.

महा- + बल महा- + बल,
 I. adj. very strong, powerful, Hit. 89, 22.
 II. m. air, wind.
 III. n. lead.
 IV. f. ला, a sort of Sida with yellow flowers, S. rhombifolia.
महा- + बाहु महा- + बाहु, and सु-महा-, adj. [] having long arms.
महा- + बुद्धि महा- + बुद्धि, adj. endowed with much intellect, Pañc. 4, 22; very sensible (ironically, Chr. 6, 7).
महा- + ब्रह्मन् महा- + ब्रह्मन्, m. a great, mighty Brāhmaṇa, Chr. 20, 18.
महा- + भट महा- + भट, m. a great warrior, Bhāg. P. 4, 25, 27. []
जगती-, भू-, मही- + भर्तृ जगती-, भू-, मही- + भर्तृ, m. a king, Rām. 2, 103, 17; Rājat. 5, 69. 23.
महा- + भाग महा- + भाग, adj. 1. eminent. 2. virtuous in a high degree, Chr. 9, 41; 24, 47; Utt. Rāmac. 38, 8.
महा- + भाग्य महा- + भाग्य, n. great luck, happiness, Sāv. 1, 1; Man. 11, 244 (Jones: Transcendent excellence).
महा- + भाण्ड महा- + भाण्ड, n. a great vessel, Pañc. 62, 25.
महा- + भीत महा- + भीत, 1. adj. very timid. 2. f. ता, a sort of sensitive plant, Mimosa pudica.
महा- + भीम महा- + भीम, 1. a name of Śāntanu. 2. one of Śiva's chamberlains.
महा- + भीष्म महा- + भीष्म, m. a name of Śāntanu.
महा- + भुज महा- + भुज, adj. having great, powerful arms, Rām. 3, 55, 4; Indr. 5, 55.
महा- + भूत महा- + भूत, n. a primary element, as earth, etc., Man. 1, 6.
महा- + मति महा- + मति, adj. highminded, Chr. 6, 4.
महा- + मद महा- + मद, m. an elephant in rut.
महा- + मनस् महा- + मनस्, adj. high-minded, magnanimous, Rām. 3, 55, 52.
महा- + मन्त्रिन् महा- + मन्त्रिन्, m. the prime minister, Hit. 97, 16.

मह् मह्, i. 1, and i. 10, Par. To adore, to honour Pañc. ii. d. 72; Kir. 5, 24. The original form was मघ् and the original signification ‘To be great, powerful.’
 --Cf. मघ, [] महन्त्, and Goth. and A.S. magan; Goth. magu, mavi, mahts; A.S. maeht, meaht, miht; Goth. mahteig; O.H.G. magan, great, heavy; A.S. maegn, meagn, strength; Goth. magus, a boy; A.S. mag, maeg, maegen, macian; Goth. magaths; A.S. maegdh; O.H.G. machôn; A.S. macian; μόγος, μόχθος, μόλις (for μόγλοις), μέγαρον (cf. O.H.G. ga-mah; N.G. Gemach), μηχανή, μηχανάομαι; Lat. magnus, mactus.
† माह् माह् (माड् माड्) i. 1, Par. Ātm. To mete, to measure.
महत्त्व महत्त्व, i. e. महन्त् + त्व, n. Greatness, Pañc. iii. d. 254; finite magnitude (as found in the त्रसरेणु), Bhāṣāp. 57.

महन्त् महन्त् (properly ptcple. pres. of मह्); the bases of all cases, except the sing. voc. msc., are महान्त् and महत्; ved. महाम् instead of महान्तम्, Chr. 297, 14 = Rigv. i. 112, 14.
 I. adj.
 1. Great, large, Vikr. 11, 18.
 2. Pre-eminent, Hit. pr. d. 28, M.M.
 3. Much, many.
 4. Excellent, Nal. 2, 25.
 II. adv. हत्, Exceedingly, much, Utt. Rāmac. 42, 2.
 III. m. The intellectual principle, Sāṅkhyak. 3, 22; Man. 12, 14.
 IV. n.
 1. Greatness, infinity, Bhāṣāp. 25.
 2. Kingdom.
 V. f. अती, The lute of Nārada.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. μέγας, μεγάλου, etc., μείζων, μέγεθος, μεγαίρω, μάλα, μᾶλλον, μῆκος, μακρός, μάκαρες; [] Lat. magis, major, majus, maximus, magister, Majus; Goth. mikils; A.S. meagol, micel, micyl, etc.; comparat. Goth. mais; A.S. ma, mae; superl. Goth. maist; A.S. maest, maegeste.

महर् महर्, and महर्लोक महर्-लोक (महर् for महन्, akin to महन्त्, or anomal. for महस्), m. The abode of the saints who survive a destruction of the world; it is said to be situated above the polar star, Weber, Ind. St. ii. 178; cf. 213; Vedāntas. in Chr. 269, 1 (महर्).
महर्द्धि महर्द्धि, i. e. महा-ऋद्धि, adj. Very perfect, Rājat. 5, 33.
महर्षि महर्षि, i. e. महा-ऋषि, m. A sage of a pre-eminent class, Man. 1, 34.

महस् मह् + अस्, n.
 1. Light, lustre, Utt. Rāmac. 15, 5; Lass. 97, 6 = Rigv. vi. 64, 2.
 2. A festival.
 3. A sacrifice.
 --Comp.
महस महस, n. Knowledge.
महात्यागमय महा-त्याग + मय, adj., f. यी, Consisting in great liberality, Kathās. 23, 84.
महानस महानस, n. A kitchen, Pañc. 253, 14.
महायशस्क महा-यशस् + क, adj. Illustrious.
महाराजिक महाराजिक, i. e. महा-राज + इक, m. A kind of demigod.
महावस महा-वस (vb. वस्), m. The Gangetic porpoise.
महासाहसिकता महा-साहसिक + ता, f. Great boldness, Pañc. 129, 22.
महि मह् + इ, ved. adj. Great.
मही मही, see मह.
महिका महिका, f. Frost.
महित्वन महि + त्वन, ved. n. Greatness, Chr. 291, 7 = Rigv. i. 85, 7.

महिमन् महिमन्, i. e. महन्त् + इमन्, m. Greatness, Hit. ii. d. 2; majesty, Vikr. d. 5; exaltation, Utt. Rāmac. 42, 2.
 --Comp.

महिला महिला, f.
 1. A woman, Hit. iv. d. 54.
 2. A plant = प्रियङ्गु.

महिष मह् + इष (cf. मह),
 I. m.
 1. A buffalo, Hit. i. d. 86, M.M.
 2. The emblem and vehicle of Yama.
 II. f. षी.
 1. The female buffalo, Pañc. ii. d. 53; 252, 15.
 2. A queen, Utt. Rāmac. 159, 9; Pañc. 27, 6.
 --Comp.
माहिष माहिष, i. e. महिष + अ, adj., f. षी, Belonging to, or coming from, a buffalo (flesh, milk, etc.), Śārṅg. 82, 219.
महीक्षित् मही-क्षि + त्, m. A king, Chr. 3, 23.

महीधर, महीध्र मही-धर, and महिद्र, i. e. महि-धृ + अ, m. A mountain, Bhartṛ. 2, 10 (ध्र).
 --Comp.
महीप मही-प (vb. 2. पा), m. A king, Pañc. i. d. 127.
महीभुज् मही-भुज्, m. A king, Hit. iii. d. 99.

महीभृत् मही-भृ + त्, m.
 1. A mountain; in मेरु-, The mountain called Meru, Kir. 5, 1.
 2. A king, Pañc. iii. d. 63.
महीमय मही + मय, adj., f. यी, Made of earth, earthen.

महीय महीय, a denomin. derived from मह, Ātm. (Par., Rām. 6, 82, 44).
 1. To be honoured, Man. 4, 260; pass. महीय्य, The same, Bhaṭṭ. 2, 38.
 2. To be exalted, Śāk. d. 194.
महीरुह् मही-रुह्, and महीरुह मही-रुह् + अ, m. A tree, Kir. 5, 10 (-रुह्); Bhāṣāp. 1 (संसार-महीरुह, The tree-like world).
महेला महेला, f. A woman (cf. महिला).
महा- + मांस महा- + मांस, n. man's flesh, Kathās. 20, 191.

महा- + मात्र महा- + मात्र,
 I. m. 1. a king's minister. 2. an elephant driver, or breaker, Man. 9, 259. 3. superintendent of the elephants. 4. a man of wealth and consequence.
 II. f. त्री. [] 1. the wife of an officer of state. 2. the wife of a spiritual teacher.
महा-मारी महा-मारी, f. a name of Durgā, Dev. 12, 7.
महा- + माष महा- + माष, m. a sort of bean, Dolichos catjang.
माहाकुल माहाकुल, i. e. महा-कुल + अ, adj. Of a respectable family.

माहात्मिक माहात्मिक, i. e. महा-आत्मन् + इक, adj.
 1. Majestic, Man. 5, 94.
 2. Of great honour.
 3. Glorious.

माहात्म्य माहात्म्य, i. e. महा-आत्मन् + य, n.
 1. Majesty, might, Utt. Rāmac. 96, 3; Pañc. 48, 18; ii. d. 52.
 2. The peculiar efficacy or virtue of a deity or sacred shrine.
 3. A work giving an account of the merits of any holy object, Dev. title.
माहित्र माहित्र, (n.), The name of a holy text, Man. 11, 249.
माहिर माहिर, m. Indra.
माहिषिक माहिषिक, i. e. महिष + इक, m. A keeper of buffaloes, Man. 3, 166.
माहिष्य माहिष्य, i. e. महिष + य, m. The offspring of a Kṣatriya father and a Vaiśya mother.
माहेन्द्र माहेन्द्र, i. e. महा-इन्द्र + अ, adj. Relating to Indra.
माहेयी माहेयी, i. e. मही + एय + ई, f. A cow.
महा- + मुख महा- + मुख, m. a crocodile.

महा- + मुनि महा- + मुनि,
 I. m. 1. a great Muni, Chr. 15, 29; Rām. 3, 49, 50 (epithet of Agastya.) 2. the saint Agastya. 3. epithet of Paraśurāma, Chr. 19, 12, and of Vyāsa. 4. time.
 II. n. Coriander.
महा-मूढ महा-मूढ, adj. very foolish, a great fool, Pañc. 38, 12.
महा- + मृग महा- + मृग, m. an elephant.
मही- + मृग मही- + मृग, m. a terrestrial deer, Rām. 3, 49, 45.
महा- + मृत्यु महा- + मृत्यु, m. Śiva.
महा- + यज्ञ महा- + यज्ञ, m. an essential ceremony, a sacrament, Man. 1, 112; 2, 28.
महा- + यन्त्र महा- + यन्त्र, n. any great mechanical work, Man. 11, 63.
महा- + यशस् महा- + यशस्, adj. illustrious, Rām. 3, 55, 38.
महा- + युग महा- + युग, n. the aggregate of the four ages.
महा- + रजत महा- + रजत, n. gold.
महा- + रजन महा- + रजन, n. 1. safflower. 2. gold.
महा- + रण महा- + रण, great battle, Chr. 23, 33.
महा- + रथ महा- + रथ, m. 1. a great chariot, Rām. 3, 55, 32. 2. (having a great chariot), a hero, ib. 3, 53, 11.
महा- + राज महा- + राज, m. 1. a sovereign, king, Vikr. 37, 9. 2. a finger-nail.
महा- + राजक महा- + राजक, and महा-राजिक, m. a kind of demigod.
महा- + राज्य महा- + राज्य, n. sovereignty, Chr. 3, 5.
महा- + रूपक महा- + रूपक, n. a drama.
महा- + रौरव महा- + रौरव, m. the name of a hell, Man. 4, 88.
महा- + लक्ष्मी महा- + लक्ष्मी, f. Sarasvatī.
महा- + ललाट महा- + ललाट, adj. with a large forehead, Rām. 3, 55, 4.
महा- + लोल महा- + लोल, m. a crow.
महा- + लोह महा- + लोह, m. the loadstone.
महा- + वंश्य महा- + वंश्य, adj. belonging to a very noble family, Rājat. 5, 337.
महा- + वक्त्र महा- + वक्त्र, adj. having a large mouth, Hiḍ. 2, 6.
महा- + वन महा- + वन, n. a large forest, Rām. 3, 55, 48.
महा- + वराह महा- + वराह and यज्ञ-, m. Viṣṇu, Johns. Sel. 94, 55 (यज्ञ-).
महा- + वाक्य महा- + वाक्य, n. a principal sentence, Vedāntas. in Chr. 210, 9; 205, 21.
महा- + वायु महा- + वायु, m. air as clement, Bhāṣāp. 43.
महिष- + वाहन महिष- + वाहन, m. Yama.
महा- + विल महा- + विल, n. 1. a cave. 2. sky, heaven. 3. the heart. 4. a water-jar.
महा- + विष महा- + विष, m. a small venomous snake, Rām. 3, 53, 55.
महा- + वीचि महा- + वीचि, m. a hell, Man. 4, 89.
महा- + वीज्य महा- + वीज्य, n. the septum of the scrotum, and part of the perinæum.
महा- + वीर महा- + वीर, m. 1. a hero. 2. a lion. 3. a white horse. 4. a sort of hawk. 5. Garuḍa. 6. Indra's thunderbolt. 7. Viṣṇu. 8. Agni. 9. sacrificial fire.

महा- + वीर्य महा- + वीर्य,
 I. adj. very strong, Rām. 3, 53, 12.
 II. m. Brahman.

महा- + वेग महा- + वेग,
 I. adj. very swift, Chr. 29, 33.
 II. m. a monkey.
महा-वेल महा-वेल, adj. of high tides, surgy, Johns. Sel. 13, 39.
महा- + व्रत महा- + व्रत, adj., f. ता, one who has undergone great austerities, Chr. 17, 27; 40, 15 (read महा-व्रतः).
महा- + व्रतिन् महा- + व्रतिन्, m. 1. a devotee, an ascetic (cf. महा-व्रत). 2. a name of Śiva.
महा- + शङ्ख महा- + शङ्ख, m. 1. the forehead. 2. a thousand millions. 3. one of Kuvera's treasures.
महा-शमी महा-शमी, f. a large Acacia Suma, Pañc. 97, 15.
महा- + शल्क महा- + शल्क, m. a prawn or shrimp, Man. 3, 272.
महा- + शस्त्र महा- + शस्त्र, n. an excellent weapon, Chr. 25, 53.
महा- + शासन महा- + शासन, a minister, Lass. 67, 10 (? cf. n.).
महा-काय-शिरोधर महा-काय-शिरोधर, adj. having a great body and neck, Rām. 3, 55, 2.
महा- + शुक्ति महा- + शुक्ति, f. the pearl oyster.
महा-शुक्ला महा-शुक्ला, f. Sarasvatī.
महा- + शुभ्र महा- + शुभ्र, n. silver.
महा- + शूद्र महा- + शूद्र, m. a cowherd. f. री, a milk-woman.
महा- + शैल महा- + शैल, m. a great mountain, Bhartṛ. 2, 56.
महा- + श्री महा- + श्री, f. epithet of Lakṣmī.
महा-कटि-तट-श्रोणी महा-कटि-तट-श्रोणी, adj. having large hips and buttocks, Indr. 2, 32.
महा- + श्वेत महा- + श्वेत, f. ता, 1. Sarasvatī. 2. candied sugar. 3. the name of two plants.
महा- + सत्त्व महा- + सत्त्व, adj. good, virtuous, Hit. 100, 12.

महा- + सन्न महा- + सन्न, m. Kuvera. आसादित,
 1. Gone to, reached.
 2. Obtained, Daśak. in Chr. 196, 5.
 3. Spread.
 4. Effected.

महा- + सह महा- + सह,
 I. adj. [] much-enduring.
 II. f. हा, the name of several plants.
महा- + सान्तपन महा- + सान्तपन, n. a severer sort of penance.
महा- + साहसिक महा- + साहसिक, m. 1. an assaulter. 2. a robber.
महा- + सिद्धि महा- + सिद्धि, f. magical power, Lass. 3, 17.

महा- + सेना महा- + सेना,
 I. adj. having a great army, Chr. 52, 12.
 II. m. 1. a general.
 2. Kārttikeya, the god of war, Vikr. d. 161.
महा-पृष्ठ-गल- + स्कन्ध महा-पृष्ठ-गल- + स्कन्ध, adj. having a large back, neck, and shoulders, Hiḍ. 2, 4.
महा- + स्थल महा- + स्थल, f. ली, the earth.

महा- + स्वन महा- + स्वन,
 I. adj. loud-sounding, Nal. 21, 5.
 II. m. 1. a loud sound. 2. a kind of drum.
महा-मेघ- + स्वन महा-मेघ- + स्वन, adj. having the sound of a large cloud, Indr. 1, 5.
महा- + स्वर महा- + स्वर, adj. crying aloud, Rām. 3, 55, 32.
महा- + हास महा- + हास, m. a horse-laugh.
